selection_basis: Day3 pairwise TabPFN v2 effect beyond same-width shuffled indicators; selected on development only

primary.multiplicity: Two prespecified primary contrasts; Bonferroni familywise95% coverage
primary.success: Both lower confidence bounds >0 and native-to-indicator mean >=0.01 nats

secondary: Gamma0 negative control and all TabICL/XGBoost contrasts are descriptive; no universal/model-selection claim
analysis: Expected log-loss, paired Student-t intervals over20 independent tasks; preserve empirical loss, oracle gaps and failures; no early stop/selection/retry on outcomes
scope: Synthetic Gaussian pairwise family at256 labels; no current-checkpoint or real-data claim
